Reference / http/status

http/status#

HTTP status codes: a case for each code of the IANA registry, and other(code) for the rest of 100-599.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

StatusCode(Status.not_found).number();          // 404
StatusCode(418).status();                       // Status.other(418)
StatusCode(503).class();                        // StatusClass.server_error
StatusCode(Status.ok).phrase();                 // "OK"

Description#

HTTP status codes: a case for each code of the IANA registry, and other(code) for the rest of 100-599.

A registered number always reads back as its own case, so Status.other(404) is refused.

An HTTP status: a case for each code of the IANA registry (snapshot 2025-09-15) and other(code) for a code the registry does not name. Its number, class and phrase come from StatusCode.

object StatusCode#

object StatusCode

The number of a status, and the status of a number (100-599). A registered number always reads back as its own case, so Status.other(404) is refused.

StatusCode(code is int)

StatusCode.phrase#

phrase() is string

IANA registry snapshot 2025-09-15. Presentation only: unknown/unused codes have no phrase, and no phrase is an HTTP/2 wire field.
